description: This PHP script handles password reset requests in the SuiteCRM/SugarCRM environment. It verifies password reset links, checks expiration, validates user input, updates passwords, and manages the user interface for password changes, including CAPTCHA verification and redirection.

classes.name: SugarView
classes.description: Handles view rendering and UI components for SuiteCRM pages.

methods.name: passwordValidationCheck
methods.description: Validates the new password according to security policies.

methods.name: retrieve_user_id
methods.description: Retrieves the user ID based on username.

methods.name: setNewPassword
methods.description: Updates the user's password in the database.
